theories.claim: Custom YAML-like parser in loadFile can silently misinterpret or drop scalar fields around list boundaries due to leadingWhitespace/section heuristic
theories.basis: loadFile at internal/platform/config/config.go:203-264 implements manual scanning: section headers detected via strings.HasSuffix(line,":") && !strings.HasPrefix(line,"-"); list field handling at 213-220 uses leadingWhitespace(raw)>0 && section!="" to clear lists, and list items only accepted when strings.HasPrefix(line,"- ") after TrimSpace. Scalar dispatch at 246-263 uses strings.SplitN(line,":",2) without handling indented colons inside quoted values. No test covers reordering of list then scalar fields except TestLoadAgentwrapListThenScalarFields at config_test.go:102-133 which succeeds for the specific order required_health -> sandbox -> permission_default but does not cover smoke.environment interleaving or qa integer fields co-located with lists.
theories.confirmation_condition: Demonstrate a valid ultraplan.yml ordering where a documented scalar field after a list is ignored, mis-assigned, or causes "unknown config field" error per parser rules
theories.refutation_condition: Show parser covers all documented YAML forms via exhaustive tests or that workspace config is generated only by code, not hand-edited
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot execute loadFile with synthetic files in this read-only shard to observe parsing outcome
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only line-by-line audit of scanner loop, whitespace logic, and listField state transitions; search for additional parser tests and handbook YAML examples
